Two boys killed in separate hit-and-run incidents

Two boys, aged two and 16, have died in separate hit-and-run incidents. The two-year-old was reportedly playing with a toy tractor when he was struck and killed in Rathkeale. Authorities named the child and released a man who had been arrested in connection with his death. In a separate incident in County Clare, a 16-year-old boy died on an e-bike. Gardaí are appealing for information and seeking a Skoda car in connection with this death.
